title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Assalam-u-alykum, I want to start the advertising company. The company operation is like this, The people who want to have advertisement through my company contact me. I have my contract to the various Autoriksha owners. I made advertisement on the autoriksha.For these tasks; I charge to the people those advertise through me and paid some portion of this amount to the autoriksha owners & rest money I take. Many times there are people?s photos (man/women/children) in the advertisement poster. Is it lawful by shariat? 1. If these poster are design by me (on the demand of the person who?s this advertise is) and then I past them on the autoriksha? 2. If these poster are designed by me (on my liking only) and then I past them on the autoriksha? 3. If these posters are designed by the person who?s this advertise is (having the photo of women/men/children) & then supplied to me & I only past them on the autoriksha? 2009 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 36523 Country: India Title: We have a commercial place to be given on rent Question: We have a commercial place to be given on rent. Can we give the same to a BANK and receive RENT in return? Answer ID: 36523 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 212/116/H=1433) Though it is allowable but it is better not to give. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
